agent_settings_channel_setting_up: Setting up. This usually finishes within a minute.
agent_settings_confirm_every_message_war: This wakes the Agent on every message in the conversation, which raises Token spend. Choose Confirm every message to apply it.
agent_settings_delete_confirmation_descr: This permanently removes the Agent and its messaging connection. The Agent cannot be restored.
agent_settings_delete_description_inacti: Permanently remove this Agent. This cannot be undone.
agent_settings_delivery_unconfirmed: Could not confirm delivery. Retrying automatically.
agent_settings_disconnect_confirmation_d: Teammates will no longer be able to assign new work to this agent until another messaging connection is added.
agent_settings_instructions_dialog_descr: These instructions guide this Agent in addition to OpenTag's platform guidance.
agent_settings_messages_delivery_pending: The channel itself is connected, but messages cannot be delivered yet. Retrying automatically.
agent_settings_messages_wait_for_compute: The channel itself is connected. Messages wait until this agent's computer is online.
agent_settings_messages_wait_for_runtime: The channel itself is connected. Messages wait until {provider} is ready on this agent's computer.
agent_settings_model_dialog_description: Choose the model and reasoning level this Agent uses.
agent_settings_no_channel_description: Teammates cannot contact this Agent until a supported bot is connected.
agent_settings_pause_confirmation_descri: This Agent is handling a request. Pausing it stops new requests, but the current request may continue until it reaches a safe stopping point.
agent_settings_pause_description: Stop accepting new requests until reactivated.
agent_settings_reconnecting_description: Reconnecting restores this Computer for every Agent that runs on it.
agent_settings_runtime_test_failed_busy: A Runtime test is already in progress on this Computer.
agent_settings_runtime_test_failed_capab: The selected Computer cannot run this Runtime test.
agent_settings_runtime_test_failed_inter: The Runtime test failed because the Provider used a tool or asked for interaction.
agent_settings_runtime_test_failed_provi: The Provider could not be started.
agent_settings_runtime_test_failed_stale: The saved Agent Runtime configuration changed. Test again to use the current configuration.
agent_settings_runtime_test_passed: Passed. This proves only that this exact invocation succeeded with the saved configuration in the selected Computer environment. It is not a durable authentication or readiness claim.
agent_settings_runtime_test_warning: This makes a real Provider request. It may consume quota and may be retained or billed by the Provider.
agent_settings_trigger_mode_all_messages: Every {destination} message is delivered and can wake this Agent, which then decides for itself whether to reply. Fastest to react, and the most Tokens.
agent_settings_trigger_mode_explanation: Every message in connected {destination} is kept as conversation history either way. This setting decides which of them wake this Agent up to act.
agent_settings_trigger_mode_mentions: Only an @mention wakes this Agent. It is then given what was said in the {destination} since its last reply, so a mention never arrives without its context.
